'''Cody DiCara''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 DecipherCon Reflections Booster Draft (6 October)]] on 6 October 2000, according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1356">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ rexbanner-goes-to-d-con], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
